name: sandboxed-browser-mcp
description: A standalone stdio MCP server that drives a sandboxed Chromium container over CDP: eleven browser tools sized for a model, with a host allowlist and untrusted-content envelope
author: Muhammad Kamran

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.stack:test:up: docker compose -p sandboxed-browser-mcp-test --env-file docker/.env.test -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.test.yaml up -d
scripts.stack:test:down: docker compose -p sandboxed-browser-mcp-test --env-file docker/.env.test -f docker/compose.yaml -f docker/compose.test.yaml down -v
